title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.12

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.12): ## Liquid AI LFM3 [LFM3](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3) is Liquid AI's new family of small models built for local agents, tool calling, and structured output, on Liquid's new tri-hybrid architecture. The family includes: - [lfm3](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3): a 1.7B text model with a 256K-token context window - [lfm3-vl](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-vl): adds image understanding - [lfm3-audio](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-audio): speech recognition, translation, and text-to-speech in 18 languages - [lfm3-omni](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-omni): text, images, and audio in one model ```sh ollama run lfm3 ``` ## d1 decision models Liquid AI's d1 models now come in a 2B size, built on LFM3. [d1](https://ollama.com/library/d1) makes decisions about text and images, and [d1-omni](https://ollama.com/library/d1-omni) adds audio. ```sh ollama run d1:2b "I was charged twice for order 4417." --ask "Is this a billing issue?" ``` Note: lfm3 and d1 2b are supported on Apple hardware
